title: Onboarding screenshot pack: model picker + request builder
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce a focused set of getting-started screenshots and annotated assets that show the Hosted API flow: model selection, request-builder UI, live code snippets (JS, Python, cURL), and the streaming response state. These assets will be used across the docs quickstart, in-product first-run experience, and the marketing ‘Start in 5 minutes’ modal. Design should include both desktop (1200w) and mobile (375w) variants and full accessibility alt text for each image.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Three hero screenshots completed: Model Picker, Request Builder (basic), Request Builder (advanced with headers & streaming).
2) Each screenshot has an annotated version (callouts) and a stripped-down clean version for docs.
3) Code snippets in JS, Python, and cURL included with proper syntax highlighting mockups.
4) All images exported at 2x and 3x PNG sizes and provided with descriptive alt text.
5) Design assets uploaded to Figma + exported asset folder to Drive; follow-up PR to docs repo created linking assets.
6) PM and Eng review completed and minor feedback addressed.
tasks: Draft model-picker hero (shows curated model list, performance badges, region selector)
Design request-builder baseline (prompt input, temperature slider, token limit, model variant selector)
Design request-builder advanced (headers, function/tool-calls toggle, streaming state with partial tokens)
Create code snippet panels for JS (fetch + SDK), Python (requests + SDK), and cURL
Write alt text for each exported image and provide short captions for docs
Export assets at required resolutions and upload to Drive & Figma
Create GH PR linking screenshots to docs quickstart and add to release notes
